title: A can. Two arms. A lot of practice.
summary: Come into the workshop for ROB's latest can-handling sessions. The short cuts keep the movement, the experiments, and the robot's personality.
transcript:
ROB lifts a red aluminum can from a table. A close-up shows the open gripper and wrist moving. From another angle, the arm repositions while holding a can, then the wrist turns. Workshop ambience and electronic sounds accompany the footage.
The gripper opens above an orange bucket, and the can falls inside with a clatter. Someone cheers: ‘Oh, oh, oh, oh! Success! He did it! He did not fail!’
In a separate close-up, another can drops into the bucket. A voice says, ‘Nice.’
The end card reads: ‘Orbitus Robotics. More ROB. Less waiting. orbitusrobotics.com/recycling.’ All motion is shown at normal speed; waits between actions have been removed.
